name: project-coordinator
description: Project coordination pipeline for software and marketing projects (content, social calendars, events, launches): refine ideas into briefs, plan work into Linear, structure project folders, and keep Linear as the source of truth with issues executable as standalone Claude prompts.

interface.shortDescription: Turn project ideas into briefs and executable Linear plans.
interface.longDescription: Coordinate software and marketing projects by refining ideas into briefs, planning standalone work in Linear, structuring project folders, and keeping the issue tracker as the source of truth.
defaultPrompt: Refine this project idea into an actionable brief.
Plan this brief as executable Linear issues.
Set up a coordinated project workflow for this launch.
